verdict.rationale: Rootly's retrospective docs say sections such as Summary, Impact, Root Cause, Mitigation, Resolution and Curated Timeline are drafted automatically from incident data, Slack and bridge transcripts. AI blocks also draft Contributing Factors, can be set up per template, and support source inspection, editing, regeneration and rating, which covers the human-review step. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI drafts follow-up action items (the docs show only inline action-item tracking in the editor), independent or hands-on corroboration of draft quality.
